write.prompt: Why is it important for young people to take part in local traditions, not just watch them? Write a body paragraph.
write.taskVi: Đoạn thân bài: câu chủ đề, WHY / HOW, ví dụ, kết quả.
mustUse: mệnh đề quan hệ xác định
mệnh đề không xác định có dấu phẩy
write.modelAfterSubmit: Young people should take part in local traditions because a tradition can only survive if someone knows how to do it. Many traditional skills, which are rarely written down, are passed on through practice. A teenager who shapes clay beside an experienced potter learns things that no photo can show, such as how wet the clay should be. For example, in my village, the teenagers who helped paint pots for the festival later joined the potters' workshop. In contrast, tourists who only take pictures leave with memories but no skills. When young people take part, they keep a tradition alive and feel proud of where they come from.
